question: Which Five-Year Plan is also known as the 'Mahalanobis Plan'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Second Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan** (1956–1961) is popularly known as the **Mahalanobis Plan**.
 
• It was formulated under the guidance of the Indian statistician **Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis**, who was a key figure in the development of planning in India.
 
• This plan focused on the **industrialization** of India and emphasized the creation of a strong base for heavy industries, such as **steel plants, machine tools, and heavy engineering industries**.
